raw_chunk: Berkshire Hathaway, controlled by Warren Buffett, acquired National Indemnity Company in 1967 for $8.6 million, marking its entrance into the insurance business. In January 1996, Berkshire completed the acquisition of the remaining 49% of GEICO for $2.3 billion, making GEICO a wholly owned subsidiary. On December 21, 1998, Berkshire acquired General Re Corporation, a holding company for global reinsurance operations. Today, Berkshire Hathaway has three main insurance subsidiaries: GEICO, General Re, and Berkshire Hathaway Reinsurance, with National Indemnity serving as the parent company for smaller insurance operations. GEICO is now the second largest private passenger auto insurer in the United States, while General Re is one of the largest professional reinsurers worldwide.

2021年，海航集团因长期高杠杆扩张最终陷入债务危机。海航集团控股海航航空集团，海航航空集团持有海南航空控股股份有限公司的大部分股权。在债务重组过程中，调查发现海航集团通过关联交易向大新华航空提供担保，大新华航空又为天津航空提供了连带担保。当大新华航空出现债务违约后，担保链条上的连锁反应导致多家子公司同时面临偿债压力。最终，海航集团被拆分为四大板块独立运营，321家子公司被打包处理。海航集团原董事长陈峰因涉嫌挪用资金和关联交易于2021年9月被警方带走。

raw_chunk: In 2012, Goldman Sachs underwrote three bond issuances for 1Malaysia Development Berhad (1MDB), a Malaysian state investment fund, raising approximately $6.5 billion. The bonds were guaranteed by the International Petroleum Investment Company (IPIC), an Abu Dhabi sovereign wealth fund. Goldman Sachs earned nearly $600 million in fees and commissions. In 2015, 1MDB missed two repayment deadlines to its domestic lenders and faced potential default. IPIC, as guarantor, was forced to cover the debt payments. Investigations revealed that approximately $2.7 billion was misappropriated from 1MDB. In October 2020, Goldman Sachs agreed to pay more than $2.9 billion in fines to settle global investigations. The SEC charged Goldman Sachs with violations of the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act.

JPMorgan Chase & Co. is the parent holding company of JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., one of the largest national banks in the United States. The bank's investment banking arm, J.P. Morgan Securities LLC, is a wholly owned subsidiary that underwrites securities and provides advisory services. In Q4 2024, JPMorgan Chase reported total assets of $4.0 trillion. The Federal Reserve Board regulates JPMorgan Chase as a bank holding company, while the SEC oversees J.P. Morgan Securities LLC for its securities activities. JPMorgan Chase Bank is also regulated by the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC). The firm's asset management division manages over $2.4 trillion in client assets.
